title: Spire and Thorn Again
author: Edmund Fairweather
blurb: Tamsin Sterling, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
